title: Agent-Supported Foresight for AI Systemic Risks: AI Agents for Breadth, Experts for Judgment

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing the generated systemic risks into PESTEL domains (Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, Legal) and measuring the concentration of outputs across these categories using the Shannon Diversity Index.

Conducting qualitative thematic analysis to compare the linguistic framing, emotional depth, and interpretive lenses of agent-generated risks (which tended to use abstract, managerial language) against human-ideated risks.
